usedFor: Slack carries team posts, and Mitto texts a number through “Send an SMS” after “New Message Posted in Channel Instant”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Send an SMS” in Mitto
bestTemplate.why: A post in an alerts channel can reach an on call phone, sent through your Mitto account.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, and texts go through your Mitto account, so pick channels carefully.
